subject: Vendr onboarding: scoped upload delegation & entitlements for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Lucas Reed <l.reed@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding — can we delegate scoped uploads for SOC 2 exhibits?

Hi Vanessa,

We're kicking off the security portal ingest for our SOC 2 refresh and would like to provision a scoped upload path into our Vendr profile for Redwood's evidence bundle. Our security team (security@clearwaterhealth.com) prefers a short-lived delegated mechanism (presigned URLs or a write-only role limited to the /clearwater/redwood/2028-04 prefix).

Can Redwood accept delegated uploads (presigned S3) and return a signed manifest + MD5 checksums? Also, are you able to apply retention metadata when you ingest (we need a 7-year retention tag and an evidence provenance manifest inserted into the profile)?

Low urgency but target: complete onboarding by 2028-04-10. Attaching our intake worksheet (delegation-scope-sheet.xlsx) and an example manifest.

Thanks,
Lucas
Sr. IT Compliance Manager
ClearWater Health

Attachments: delegation-scope-sheet.xlsx, example-manifest.json

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Lucas Reed <l.reed@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — can we delegate scoped uploads for SOC 2 exhibits?

Hi Lucas — thanks for the details and the worksheet. We can support a delegated workflow; proposed approach below:  

1) Presigned upload windows: Redwood can accept a batch of presigned PUT URLs. We prefer one-hour windows per upload job and a single prefix per customer to keep the ingestion pipeline deterministic (/clearwater/redwood/2028-04/).

2) Role & entitlements: for ongoing delegated uploads we recommend a temporary, write-only "evidence-uploader" IAM role scoped to that prefix. If you need Redwood to generate the presigned URLs we can do that after you approve a short DocuSign consent for delegated upload access.

3) Manifest & validation: please include a CSV manifest (we've attached a template: redwood-evidence-index-template.csv) with MD5 and logical document type (SOC2-A, SOC2-B, CAIQ, SIG). Our ingest pipeline will validate checksums, run a quick malware scan, and attach the provenance fields (retention: 7y, source: clearwater-vendr-onboard, ingested_by: vanessa_ortiz) to each record metadata.

4) Evidence retention & deletions: we will mark objects with the retention tag but will not delete anything before the retention period unless you request an exception in writing.

Next steps for us: Ben (security) and Mina (evidence ops), can you confirm the presign template and whether Redwood should host the presigned generation endpoint? Lucas — if you can share whether you prefer us to (A) host presigned URLs for you, or (B) you provide presigned URLs from your S3, we'll take that path.

I'll prepare a short DocuSign consent for the delegation flow — low-risk, scoped to the prefix and with an automatically-expiring window.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-evidence-index-template.csv, vendr-presign-guidance.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendr onboarding — delegated uploads approach (security POV)

Vanessa — quick notes from security:  

- Presigned URLs are fine if we enforce one-hour expirations and require HTTPS. We should insist on server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) for any S3 object that lands in our pipeline.  
- Our upload validation should include: checksum match, Content-Type assertion, and a virus scan. If any file fails validation we should quarantine and notify CW.
- For entitlements, "evidence-uploader" write-only is correct; do NOT grant list/delete at the prefix level. Read should be limited to our ingest pipeline service account only.

Mina — can you confirm ops can accept a zipped batch + manifest and perform the automated checks? Also confirm the expected SLA for manifest processing (we normally aim for < 45 minutes for a 1-5GB batch).

Ben

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Lucas Reed <l.reed@clearwaterhealth.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — final details & DocuSign link

Hi Lucas — confirming we can accept presigned PUTs (option A preferred) or your presigned URLs (option B) with the manifest pattern Vanessa included. Operational notes: 

- Please use the attached CSV template and include a per-file md5 column and a top-level batch_id. We will reject any batch where checksums fail.
- Processing SLA: typical turnaround is 30–45 minutes for a single batch under 2GB; for larger batches we'll provide a job ticket and ETA.

I created the DocuSign envelope for consent to allow Redwood to generate presigned URLs and to apply the retention metadata. Sign here: https://app.docusign.com/secure/clearwater-delegate-consent  

Once signed we'll either: (1) generate presigned URLs for your ingestion window and send back the upload manifest (preferred), or (2) accept your presigned URLs and ingest immediately.

Attaching: vendr-presign-guidance.pdf (short checklist) and delegation-scope-sheet.xlsx.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Evidence Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendr-presign-guidance.pdf, delegation-scope-sheet.xlsx
